flawless: When I charge, every blade beside me grows sharper. Yours never had a chance.
The Stromgald name was forged in snow and fire. You were neither.
solid: You fought like a true northerner. Almost.
My shield arm aches. A good ache, the kind you earn.
close: By ice and ember! I nearly lost my name to you today.
My men are scattered and my horse is limping. What a fight!
